operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm run verify && pnpm check:deployment-spec
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: retain the exact source revision, pause writes and scheduled notices, export the private D1 records and FILES objects, restore into fresh empty resources with the matching release, establish a fresh owner, re-export and compare records and object bytes before routing traffic. Preserve every applied migration name and its bytes.
